t2s.dissolvestereo: The original DissolveStereo animates the first frame with its own video model, so its left view is a different, 16-frame video.
t2s.svg: SVG returns 16 frames of a vertically centred crop at its own resolution.
t2s.stereocrafter: StereoCrafter works on the top-left 768×384 crop of the left view.

v2s.dissolvestereo: The original DissolveStereo animates the first frame with its own video model, so its left view is a different, 16-frame video.
v2s.svg: SVG returns the first 16 frames of the clip.

examples.name: Potter's wheel
examples.text: A potter's wheel with wet clay turning, the potter's hands above it, shelves of bisque ware in the background.

look.dissolvestereo: Look behind the potter's hands: DissolveStereo leaves traces of the foreground in the newly visible background, which StereoGraft fills.
look.dissolvestereo-dagger: Look behind the potter's hands: DissolveStereo† leaves traces of the foreground in the newly visible background, which StereoGraft fills.
look.svg: SVG frays the edge of the pot; StereoGraft keeps it whole.
look.stereocrafter: StereoCrafter leaves black gaps behind the hands, which StereoGraft fills.

examples.name: Carousel horse
examples.text: A carousel horse standing still in the foreground, painted and chipped, the rest of the ride and a fairground behind it at dusk.

look.dissolvestereo: The original DissolveStereo adds a second horse.
look.dissolvestereo-dagger: DissolveStereo† streaks the background behind the horse.
look.svg: The paper has no note on this pair: compare the background beside the horse.
look.stereocrafter: StereoCrafter leaves black gaps beside the horse.

examples.name: Rope bridge
examples.text: A rope bridge's first planks filling the foreground, the span sagging away across a gorge, far cliffs in haze.

look.dissolvestereo: The original DissolveStereo bends the deck of the bridge.
look.svg: The paper has no note on this pair: compare the deck and the railing.
look.stereocrafter: StereoCrafter leaves gaps along the bridge.

examples.name: Excavator
examples.text: Stereo4D test clip: an excavator's bucket close to the camera, a harbour behind it.

look.dissolvestereo: The original DissolveStereo doubles the bucket.
look.dissolvestereo-dagger: DissolveStereo† blurs the lower edge of the arm.

examples.name: Utility pole
examples.text: Stereo4D test clip: a street from a moving camera, a utility pole close on the left.

look.dissolvestereo: The paper has no note on this pair: follow the utility pole.
look.dissolvestereo-dagger: Follow the utility pole: DissolveStereo† adds stripes along it, and with StereoGraft it keeps a single outline.
look.svg: Follow the utility pole: SVG leaves a faint second pole, and with StereoGraft it keeps a single outline.
look.stereocrafter: Follow the utility pole: StereoCrafter breaks up the background alongside it.
